@adonis-agora/agent's SSE handler waits for the first event before sending headers, so a resumed stream on an idle conversation never answers; dpa's sse has no header deadline, so the control call never returns (HTTP 0).
adonis-agora's poppy-client signs client and Session assertions without typ: "JWT"; dpa-mock requires it (S2 reading; mock violation client-assertion.typ).

poppyseed returns a POST ?wait as soon as any event follows the cursor (or ignores it), with status working and no reply; the scenario expects the reply in the send result. Poppy 7.3 makes wait a hint, so CA should read with wait after the send, as C does.
